title: Add an iOS demo app with UI tests and an iOS CI job
description: Add an iOS demo app with UI tests and an iOS CI job
no_spec_change_rationale: The demo app, its UI tests and the CI workflow exercise existing behaviour and change no library source or canonical spec
acceptance_criteria: xcodegen generate then xcodebuild test of the DemoApp scheme passes on an iOS simulator: the package's unit tests run inside the app, including the Keychain and SecureState tests, and the five UI tests pass, including persisted state surviving an app relaunch; the iOS workflow passes on the pull request
